feature.name: Resume Builder
feature.description: Step-by-step resume builder that allows users to create professional resumes from scratch with an intuitive interface and real-time preview.

architecture.pattern: Feature-based architecture with React hooks and local state management
architecture.state_management: - React hooks (useState, useEffect, useCallback) - Custom useBuilder hook for managing builder state - localStorage for automatic data persistence

main_page.name: BuilderPage
main_page.description: Main page component that orchestrates the resume building process. Features: - Step-by-step navigation with visual progress indicator in Header - Sticky Header (position: sticky, top: 0, zIndex: 1000) - Step names hidden on mobile devices (only numbered circles shown) - Real-time resume preview (on desktop) - Responsive layout (2-column on desktop, single column on mobile) - Progress bar showing completion percentage - Auto-save to localStorage - Uses shared Header component with custom builder steps - Compact input fields with RefinePage styling (12px font, #F9FAFB background)

component.name: ContactInfoStep
component.description: Form for entering contact information (first step): - Full name (first + last name) - Email (required) - Phone number - City/Country - Visual validation with checkmarks - Compact input styling (12px font, #F9FAFB background, 6px border-radius) - H5 title (1.5rem), body2 description (14px)

component.name: WorkExperienceStep
component.description: Dynamic form for adding multiple work experiences: - Automatically creates first empty experience entry on load - Job title, company, location - Start/end dates with "current position" option - Multiple achievements per position - Add/delete functionality - Compact input styling (12px font, #F9FAFB background) - H5 title (1.5rem), body2 description (14px)

component.name: EducationStep
component.description: Form for adding educational background: - Automatically creates first empty education entry on load - Degree, institution, field of study - Location (city, country) - Start/end dates - Add/delete multiple entries - Compact input styling (12px font, #F9FAFB background) - H5 title (1.5rem), body2 description (14px)

component.name: SkillsStep
component.description: Skills management interface: - Add skills via text input + Enter or button click - Display as chips with delete functionality - Visual tips for better skill selection

component.name: SummaryStep
component.description: Professional summary editor: - Multi-line text area - Character counter - Tips for writing effective summaries

service.name: BuilderStorageService
service.description: Manages localStorage persistence: - get(): Retrieve current builder state - save(): Save complete or partial state - updateField(): Update specific field - markStepCompleted(): Track completed steps - clear(): Remove all data - initialize(): Set up default state if not exists

hook.name: useBuilder
hook.description: Custom hook for builder state management: - state: Current builder state - updateField(): Update any field in state - goToStep(): Navigate to specific step - goToNextStep(): Move to next step - goToPreviousStep(): Move to previous step - isStepCompleted(): Check if step is completed - canGoNext/canGoBack(): Navigation validation - getNextStepLabel(): Get label for next step - clearBuilder(): Reset all data - getProgress(): Calculate completion percentage

file.name: builder.ts
file.description: TypeScript types and interfaces: - BuilderStep: Union type of all steps - BuilderStepConfig: Configuration for each step - BuilderState: Extended ResumeData with builder metadata - BUILDER_STEPS: Array of step configurations

step.name: Contacts
step.description: User enters personal and contact information (starting step)

step.name: Experience
step.description: User adds work history with responsibilities. First empty entry is automatically created.

step.name: Education
step.description: User adds educational background. First empty entry is automatically created.

step.name: Finish
step.description: User completes builder, data is saved to backend, localStorage cleared, and user navigates to refine page

navigation.description:
Builder is integrated into main application flow and appears in header navigation. Navigation structure: 1. Start (/start) - Initial page for creating resume 2. Builder (/builder) - Step-by-step resume construction (replaces "Generate" in header) 3. Refine (/refine) - AI-powered refinement and editing 4. Export (/export) - Template selection and download
All pages (Start, Refine, Export) now navigate to Builder instead of Chat (/chat). Builder appears as step 2 in the main header stepper across all pages.

feature.name: Auto-save
feature.description: All changes are automatically saved to localStorage on each update

feature.name: Progress Tracking
feature.description: Visual stepper in Header and progress bar show completion status

feature.name: Header Integration
feature.description: Builder steps are displayed in the main Header using customSteps prop, allowing direct navigation between steps

feature.name: Real-time Preview
feature.description: Desktop users see live preview of resume as they build (hidden on mobile)

feature.name: Responsive Design
feature.description: Optimized for mobile, tablet, and desktop screens. Mobile: Step labels hidden, only numbered circles shown. Desktop: Full step names displayed.

feature.name: Compact Input Fields
feature.description: All input fields use compact RefinePage styling: - Font size: 12px - Padding: 8px 12px - Background: #F9FAFB - Border: 1px solid #e5e7eb - Border radius: 6px

feature.name: Auto-initialization
feature.description: Work Experience and Education steps automatically create first empty entry on mount. User sees form fields immediately instead of "Add" button.

feature.name: Navigation
feature.description: Step-by-step navigation with Back/Next buttons in form, plus direct step selection in Header

colors.usage: - Primary colors for buttons and accents - Success colors for validation indicators - Grey palette for backgrounds and borders - Secondary colors for tips and highlights

internationalization.description: All text content is externalized to i18n files under the "builder" namespace: - builder.steps.*: Step names - builder.getStarted.*: Welcome screen text - builder.contactInfo.*: Contact form labels - builder.workExperience.*: Work experience form - builder.education.*: Education form - builder.skills.*: Skills section - builder.summary.*: Summary section - builder.navigation.*: Navigation buttons - builder.preview.*: Preview panel

routing.description: Accessible to both authenticated and guest users who have completed onboarding

enhancement.name: Resume Upload
enhancement.description: Allow users to upload existing resume and parse into builder format

enhancement.name: AI Suggestions
enhancement.description: Provide AI-powered suggestions for improving content

enhancement.name: Cloud Sync
enhancement.description: Save builder state to backend for authenticated users
